sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Execute the full BFS path from start
path = ['UP', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'UP']
result = action(path, intent='solve')
print(f"Result: done={last_action_result.get('done')}, level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}, game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
print(f"Step: {current_frame.step}, Level: {current_frame.level}")

# Check agent position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
block_rows = [22, 25, 28, 31, 34]
block_cols = [13, 16, 19, 22, 25, 28, 31, 34, 37, 40, 43, 46, 49]
blue_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
for n in blue_nodes:
    center_r = sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
    center_c = sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary']) / len(n['boundary'])
    br = next(i for i, y in enumerate(block_rows) if abs(center_r - y) < 2)
    bc = next(j for j, x in enumerate(block_cols) if abs(center_c - x) < 2)
    print(f"Agent at ({br}, {bc})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
